title: Goldfish reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fish body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='55' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='63' rx='18' ry='10' fill='#FFC966'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='14,55 2,38 6,55 2,72' fill='#FF6A00'/>
  <polygon points='14,55 4,45 7,55 4,65' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- top fin -->
  <polygon points='35,36 44,28 52,37' fill='#FF6A00'/>
  <!-- side fin -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='60' rx='8' ry='4' transform='rotate(-20 38 60)' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#1A237E'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='47' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M53 60 Q58 65 63 60' stroke='#FF6A00' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- open book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 78 72)'>
    <!-- left page -->
    <polygon points='68,60 80,58 80,82 68,80' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
    <!-- right page -->
    <polygon points='80,58 92,60 92,80 80,82' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <!-- spine -->
    <line x1='80' y1='58' x2='80' y2='82' stroke='#D9A441' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- page lines left -->
    <line x1='71' y1='65' x2='77' y2='64' stroke='#B0BEC5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='71' y1='69' x2='77' y2='68' stroke='#B0BEC5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='71' y1='73' x2='77' y2='72' stroke='#B0BEC5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <!-- page lines right -->
    <line x1='83' y1='64' x2='89' y2='65' stroke='#B0BEC5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='83' y1='68' x2='89' y2='69' stroke='#B0BEC5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='83' y1='72' x2='89' y2='73' stroke='#B0BEC5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- viewport friendly highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='46' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#FFB347' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
